test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting in a straight line facing north. No one sits to the left of K. Only four people sit between K and J. L sits second to the left of J. D sits to the immediate left of B. C is not an immediate neighbour of L. How many people sit between L and C?
solution:
Given: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting in a straight line facing north.

No one sits to the left of K.

Only four people sit between K and J.

L sits second to the left of J.

D sits to the immediate left of B.

C is not an immediate neighbour of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12019a88cb6335631349e887e11b6b04efb50a368531a230b2dede9d4f4ea6df.png] 

So, There are **Two** people sit between L and C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
